inputs.original_text: It's heartbreaking how this Iran war keeps grinding on, with energy prices spiking and hitting working families and the poorest communities hardest, flights grounded, and endless scenes of death and destruction dominating our screens. Bloomberg points out that people everywhere are demanding an end to what they see as a poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's a clear peril to global well-being. Yet the public in Israel remains strongly behind pushing it forward without a clear end in sight. This stark divide exposes how militaristic policies rooted in historical power imbalances and institutional biases continue to sacrifice vulnerable populations worldwide while shielding those in positions of relative privilege from the full human and economic costs.
inputs.modified_text: This war in Iran is dragging on as another brutal example of how militaristic policies rooted in historical power imbalances and institutional biases keep exploiting the most vulnerable. Energy prices are spiking and slamming working families along with the poorest communities hardest, flights are grounded, and our screens are flooded with nonstop death and destruction. Bloomberg is pointing out the global outcry demanding an end to this poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's endangering well-being for everyone. Yet the public in Israel stays firmly behind pushing it forward with no clear end in sight. This stark divide makes it obvious that these kinds of aggressions sacrifice marginalized populations worldwide while shielding the privileged from the full human and economic costs.
